authority: Post-V10 engineering sensitivity. This study does not amend the frozen V10 release or the 2026-09-03 handoff-v1 package.

interpretation.meaning: Bulk chamber cavity depth normal to the bulk-cavity footprint, per side. It is not a membrane dimension.
interpretation.alternate_interpretation_screened: A separate sensitivity reports what would happen if 20 mm instead meant the local membrane gap.

membrane_constraint.design_rule: The active membrane window remains 50 x 50 mm (25 cm2) within the existing 80 x 80 mm coupon. The larger bulk chamber footprint is only a gas-volume plenum and must transition symmetrically to the unchanged membrane window.

plate_model.boundary_condition: Conservative simply-supported square thin-plate pressure screen over the full 165 mm bulk-cavity span; the active membrane remains 50 x 50 mm.
plate_model.stress_method: Navier double-series centre bending moment with material-specific Poisson ratio.
plate_model.limitations: Pressure-only linear-elastic screen. Bolt-point loads, seal compression, holes, creep, thermal gradients and local membrane-frame loads are excluded.

fasteners.choice: 16 x M5 A4 stainless fasteners at approximately 45-50 mm perimeter spacing, with hard compression stops and spring washers.

seal.choice: Two continuous EPDM 70 Shore A static face seals separated by the existing vented guard groove.

drawing_starting_tolerances.primary_datum: A = membrane/seal plane; B and C = orthogonal cavity centre planes.

ports.choice: Candidate: two 316 stainless 6 mm-OD bulkhead compression fittings per side with 4 mm-ID flow path, isolated by valves during the sealed transient.
ports.volume_boundary: The calculation includes only the existing header, pressure tap and two ideal cylindrical wall bores. Actual fitting, tube and isolation-valve volumes require CAD or measurement.

fan.choice: One identical PWM fan per chamber, recessed or edge-mounted, operated continuously and symmetrically after thermal equilibration.

baffle.choice: Two removable 1 mm PEEK turning/diffuser vanes per side, at least 60% open area and no more than 2.0 mL total solid displacement.

humidity_sensor.use_boundary: Suitable for quasi-static/end-point checks, but not sufficient by itself to resolve the model's 0.1 s samples or prove sub-segment mixing.

electrical_feedthrough.choice: Removable six-pin hermetic glass-to-metal or ceramic bulkhead feedthrough; avoid an unqualified potted cable gland in the measurement volume.
electrical_feedthrough.weakness: Higher cost and larger intrusion than a potted gland; metal shells require deliberate electrical isolation/grounding.

pressure_management.choice: Two symmetric gas-tight compliant diaphragms referenced to the same external pressure, or one low-stiction double-acting diaphragm. Do not directly cross-connect the humid chambers.
pressure_management.weakness: Diaphragm stiffness, hysteresis, permeation and added calibrated volume must be measured; a gas cross-connection would corrupt the humidity inventory.
